nodes.label: Ponytail
nodes.definition: Lazy senior developer mode for coding agents. A discipline that prioritizes shipping the minimum working solution by following a decision ladder: YAGNI → stdlib → native platform features → one-liner → minimum code.

nodes.label: Decision Ladder
nodes.definition: A five-rung prioritization framework for code decisions: 1) Does this need to exist (YAGNI)? 2) Already in codebase? 3) Stdlib has it? 4) Platform native? 5) Installed dependency? 6) Can it be one line? 7) Minimum code.

nodes.label: YAGNI
nodes.definition: You Aren't Gonna Need It. First rung: speculative features are skipped, no abstractions with one implementation, no config that never changes.

nodes.label: Stdlib & Native First
nodes.definition: Rungs 2-4 of the ladder. Before writing code or adding dependencies, check: codebase reuse, standard library equivalents, platform-native features.

nodes.label: Platform-Native Solutions
nodes.summary: Comprehensive reference of platform-native capabilities across HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, Node.js, Swift, and databases that replace external dependencies.

nodes.label: Agentic Benchmark (2026-06-18)
nodes.summary: Real-world benchmark on fastapi-template comparing ponytail vs baseline Claude Code vs caveman vs YAGNI one-liner. Measures LOC, tokens, cost, time, and safety. Results: ponytail −54% LOC on features, 100% safe on security tasks.

nodes.label: Comprehension & Reuse Benchmark (2026-06-22)
nodes.summary: Addresses issues #245 (root-cause fix) and #217 (codebase reuse). Tests trace-transfer bug fix and reuse patterns. Results: Sonnet/Opus 6/6 root-cause fixes with new comprehension directive, rung 2 ships.

nodes.label: ponytail (Skill)
nodes.definition: Core ponytail skill. Lazy senior dev mode, always-on context. Implements the decision ladder and minimal-code discipline.

nodes.label: ponytail-review (Skill)
nodes.definition: Over-engineering review on a diff. Tags findings as delete, stdlib, native, yagni, or shrink. One-shot report.

nodes.label: ponytail-audit (Skill)
nodes.definition: Whole-repo audit for over-engineering. Scans entire codebase instead of diff. Ranked list of what to delete, simplify, or replace. One-shot report.

nodes.label: ponytail-debt (Skill)
nodes.definition: Harvest ponytail: comment markers into a tracked debt ledger. Ensures deliberate shortcuts and deferrals don't rot into permanent tech debt.

nodes.label: ponytail-gain (Skill)
nodes.definition: Display ponytail's measured impact as a compact scoreboard. Shows less code, less cost, more speed from benchmark medians.

nodes.label: ponytail-help (Skill)
nodes.definition: Quick-reference card for all ponytail modes, skills, and commands. One-shot display for user guidance.

nodes.label: Agent Portability
nodes.summary: Ponytail adapters for 30+ hosts: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Hermes, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, CodeWhale, Swival, Zed, Qoder, and more.

nodes.label: Email Validation Example
nodes.summary: Without Ponytail: 75 lines. With Ponytail: 3 lines. Shows regex-based validation using native pattern matching.

nodes.label: Debounce Example
nodes.summary: Without Ponytail: 116 lines with detailed patterns. With Ponytail: 10 lines. Inline debounce using native setTimeout/clearTimeout.

nodes.label: CSV Sum Example
nodes.summary: Without Ponytail: 20 lines with pandas. With Ponytail: 3 lines with csv module.

nodes.label: Countdown Timer Example
nodes.summary: Without Ponytail: 267 lines with styled components and features. With Ponytail: 9 lines core timer.

nodes.label: Rate Limiting Example
nodes.summary: Without Ponytail: 128 lines showing 6 approaches. With Ponytail: 10 lines using slowapi.

nodes.label: Deep Clone Example
nodes.summary: Without Ponytail: lodash dependency or fragile JSON.parse hack. With Ponytail: structuredClone built-in (modern browsers/Node 17+).

nodes.label: Group By Example
nodes.summary: Without Ponytail: lodash dependency. With Ponytail: Object.groupBy native API (Chrome 117+, Node 21+).

nodes.label: Infinite Scroll Example
nodes.summary: Without Ponytail: react-infinite-scroll-component dependency. With Ponytail: IntersectionObserver native API.

nodes.label: Modal Dialog Example
nodes.summary: Without Ponytail: @radix-ui or react-modal + 30 lines. With Ponytail: native <dialog> element + 8 lines.

nodes.label: Number Formatting Example
nodes.summary: Without Ponytail: numeral/accounting dependency. With Ponytail: Intl.NumberFormat native API.

nodes.label: URL Parameters Example
nodes.summary: Without Ponytail: query-string dependency (4.5kB, 3.5M downloads/week). With Ponytail: URLSearchParams native API.

nodes.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
nodes.definition: Model used in benchmarks (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001). Benchmarks also cover Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8.

nodes.label: Safety Validation
nodes.definition: Deterministic execution of produced functions against adversarial input (path traversal, SQL injection, forged tokens, malformed CSV, quota exhaustion). Benchmark safety metric: ponytail 100% safe, baseline 100% safe, yagni-oneliner 95% safe.

nodes.label: Hermes Plugin Config
nodes.summary: Native Hermes Agent plugin manifest. Exposes ponytail through pre_llm_call hook and provides bundled skills as ponytail:<skill>.

nodes.label: ponytail-mcp
nodes.summary: MCP server that serves ponytail instructions via Prompt and Tool interfaces. Supports mode selection (lite/full/ultra) with config resolution (env var > config file > default).

code_reduction.label: Code Reduction Achievement
code_reduction.description: Measurable reductions in lines of code by applying ponytail discipline

safety_guarantees.label: Safety Without Compromise
safety_guarantees.description: Ponytail maintains 100% safe rate on security tasks while reducing code
safety_guarantees.evidence: Benchmark axis 2: deterministic security checks (path traversal, SQL injection, etc.) show ponytail 100% safe vs yagni-oneliner 95% safe
safety_guarantees.rule: Never simplify away input validation at trust boundaries

root_cause_fixing.label: Root Cause Fixing
root_cause_fixing.description: Fix bugs once in shared code, not once per caller
root_cause_fixing.evidence: Issue #245: comprehension directive improved Sonnet/Opus from 1/6 to 6/6 root-cause fixes
root_cause_fixing.operational_principle: Grep every caller of the function you touch and fix the shared function once

codebase_reuse.label: Codebase Reuse
codebase_reuse.description: Before writing new code, check if it already exists in the project
codebase_reuse.evidence: Issue #217: rung 2 added to ensure internal reuse is checked before stdlib/native
